items.title: Wilbur DeParis Interview, 1959-06-26
items.q: I forget their first names there was brother there were brothers Wolfscale brothers and I think Roy was the name of one of them

ctx.x: was this Roy Wolfscale that went to Chicago that you were referring to
I forget their first names there was brother there were brothers Wolfscale brothers and I think Roy was the name of one of them
Paul Balburn had mentioned them to me I wondered if it was the same fellows
